Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: After identifying the primary source (the YouTube “Oh No – PART 1” video), the agent failed to engage or extract content from it and pivoted to indirect searches instead. This strategy error—ignoring the key source and relying on secondary pages—led to repeated unproductive searches and eventual failure to find the on-screen phrase (later compounded by misusing a scraper on a Fandom page), resulting in the incorrect “Unable to determine” outcome.
